dialogue.content: 本日は宜しくお願いします。時間になったら始めさせていただきます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming today. We will begin now that it's our scheduled time.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ宜しくお願いします！
dialogue.English: Thank you. It's a pleasure to be here!

dialogue.content: こんばんは初めに年齢と性別、今日お話ししたいことを教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Good evening. To start, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: こんばんは、40代、女性です
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm a woman in my 40s.

dialogue.content: 親との関係に悩んでます
dialogue.English: I’m struggling with my relationship with my parents.

dialogue.content: 教えていただいてありがとうございます。親御様とのご関係で悩まれているんですね。ちなみにお父様、お母様どちらとのご関係でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. So you're struggling with your relationship with your parents. May I ask if it's with your father or your mother?

dialogue.content: 両親ですが、どちらかと言うと母親との関係でしょうか
dialogue.English: It's with both of them, but if I had to say, it’s more my relationship with my mother.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。どういったことで悩まれているのか教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Could you tell me more about what’s been troubling you?

dialogue.content: はい、私が独身でいるのを心配して、いつも結婚しろと言われて嫌なんです
dialogue.English: Yes, they're worried about me being single, and I hate that they're always telling me to get married.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。いつもそう言われると嫌なお気持ちになるのも自然な事かと思います。
dialogue.English: I understand. I think it's perfectly natural to feel upset when you're always being told that.

dialogue.content: はい、うるさく思ってしまって、着信も無視してます
dialogue.English: Yes, I find it so annoying that I've been ignoring their calls.

dialogue.content: そうなっても仕方ない事かと思います。ちなみにご両親様とは一緒に住まれてはいないのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I can understand why you would do that. By the way, are you living with your parents?

dialogue.content: はい、今は別です
dialogue.English: That's right, we live separately now.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それでお電話がかかってくるんですね。それは少し困ってしまいますね
dialogue.English: I see. So that's why they call you. That must be a bit difficult for you.

dialogue.content: あんまり無視し続けても心配かけるからと、時々は話しますが、長話で説教されます
dialogue.English: I know they'll worry if I ignore them too much, so I do talk to them sometimes, but it always turns into a long lecture.

dialogue.content: 心配かけまいと時々はお電話に出られてお話しているんですね。ご両親思いだと思います。ちなみにご兄弟はいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: So you answer their calls sometimes because you don't want them to worry. I think that's very considerate of you. By the way, do you have any siblings?

dialogue.content: 妹がいますが、妹は結婚して子どもがいます
dialogue.English: I have a younger sister, but she's married and has children.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか妹さんとは何かこのことについてお話されたりしますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Do you ever talk to your sister about this?

dialogue.content: 話しません、妹とも離れてますし、彼女も仕事しながら子育てで忙しいと思います
dialogue.English: No, I don't. I live far from my sister, and I imagine she's busy raising her kids while working.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね妹さんもお忙しいとなかなかお話しにくいですよねご家族にお優しい方なのかなと感じました。
dialogue.English: I understand. It can be hard to talk when your sister is so busy. I get the sense you’re very considerate of your family.

dialogue.content: そうでしょうか、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Do you think so? Thank you.

dialogue.content: ご両親のお電話では結婚してほしいといわれているとのことでしたが、ご自身は今はお仕事でお忙しくされているように感じましたがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned your parents tell you they want you to get married, but it sounds to me like you're busy with work right now. Is that the case?

dialogue.content: 仕事は時期にもよります。今は年度末で忙しい時期ですが…
dialogue.English: My work depends on the time of year. It's busy right now because it's the end of the fiscal year, but...

dialogue.content: そうでしたか今はお忙しいんですねそんな中お電話がしょっちゅうかかってくると嫌なお気持ちになってしまうんですね
dialogue.English: I see, so you're busy at the moment. Receiving frequent calls during such a time must be upsetting.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お説教が長いとのことでしたがどんなお話をされているんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned the lectures are long. What kinds of things do they say?

dialogue.content: いつまで独身でいるつもりなんだ、とか、結婚相談所に行ってみなさい、とか
dialogue.English: Things like, 'How long do you plan on being single?' and 'Why don't you try a matchmaking service?'

dialogue.content: なるほど、、どうしても結婚してほしいんですねそんな時どう返されているんでしょうか
dialogue.English: I see... They really want you to get married. How do you usually respond in those situations?

dialogue.content: わかってます、考えてます、と
dialogue.English: I tell them, “I know, I’m thinking about it.”

dialogue.content: 言ってきました
dialogue.English: That’s what I’ve been saying.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねそのように答えられているんですね。実際はどのように思っていらっしゃるのか教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how you've been responding. Could you tell me how you actually feel about it?

dialogue.content: 実際は、もしかしたら結婚は無理かもしれないと思ってます
dialogue.English: Honestly, I think marriage might not be possible for me.

dialogue.content: どうしてその様に思われているんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What leads you to feel that way?

dialogue.content: 歳も歳ですし、恋人もいません
dialogue.English: Well, because of my age, and I don't have a partner.

dialogue.content: 結婚願望はあるが年齢のことを考えられているということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So you do want to get married, but you’re concerned about your age—is that right?

dialogue.content: 正直、願望も自分ではよくわからないです。年齢的に子どもは無理でしょうし
dialogue.English: Honestly, I'm not even sure what I want myself. And having children is likely out of the question at my age.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね結婚したいかわからずに結婚のために動くのは嫌ですよね
dialogue.English: I see. It must be difficult to take steps towards marriage when you're not even sure if that's what you want.

dialogue.content: 親の思いはわからないでもないですが、私には応えられないかもしれないです
dialogue.English: It's not that I don't understand how my parents feel, but I might not be able to meet their expectations.

dialogue.content: そう思われているんですねご両親もご心配な気持ちも理解できてお辛いんですね。それでもご自身のお考えが一番大切なのかなと思います。
dialogue.English: So that's how you feel. It must be painful to understand your parents' concerns yet feel unable to meet them. Even so, I think what you want for yourself is the most important thing.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: それでいつか結婚に興味を持たれる日がくれば年齢や子供のことは考えず、活動してみてもいいのかもしれません。
dialogue.English: And if a day comes when you do become interested in marriage, perhaps you could try putting yourself out there without worrying about your age or having children.

dialogue.content: 婚活パーティーとか好きじゃないし、あんまり男性とも話したことないから今の私には無理です
dialogue.English: I don't like things like matchmaking parties, and I haven't really talked to many men, so it's impossible for me right now.

dialogue.content: そうでしたかお見合いはどうでしょう間に入ってくれる方がいます。
dialogue.English: I see. How about an arranged meeting? You would have a person to mediate.

dialogue.content: そういうのもあまり好きじゃないです。母親みたいなお節介なタイプも苦手で…
dialogue.English: I don't really like that sort of thing either. I'm not good with meddlesome types, like my mother...

dialogue.content: なるほど色々いわれたらしんどくなりそうですね
dialogue.English: I understand. It sounds like it would be exhausting to be told what to do all the time.

dialogue.content: 結婚してたら良かったと思いますが、どうしようもないですね
dialogue.English: I do think it would have been nice to be married, but there's nothing I can do about it now.

dialogue.content: 過去にということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do you mean in the past?

dialogue.content: そうですね、もう遅いけど。
dialogue.English: Yes, but it's too late now.

dialogue.content: したい方がいらっしゃったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Was there someone you wanted to marry?

dialogue.content: 付き合った人はいたので。一応
dialogue.English: Well, I have been in relationships before.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですねもちろん結婚しない人生もしない人生もどちらがいいとは思いませんが、年齢は何歳でもできるのかなと思います。
dialogue.English: I see. Of course, I don't believe a life with marriage is inherently better than one without, but I do think marriage is something that's possible at any age.

dialogue.content: そうですね、少し考えてみます
dialogue.English: You’re right. I’ll think about it a bit.

dialogue.content: お時間になってしまいましたがまたお話したいことあればいつでもこちらに来てください。またお話しましょう
dialogue.English: It looks like our time is up, but please feel free to come back anytime if there's more you'd like to talk about. Let's talk again.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました。終了のメッセージが流れます。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. A closing message will now play.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました。お手数ですがフィードバックお願いします）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much. Please take a moment to provide your feedback.)
